lines.text: Many learners say: She is good in English.
Better: She is good at English.
At! He is good at sports.

native.tip: 잘한다는 good at! “She is good at English”예요.
native.caption: “She is good in English”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 어떤 분야를 잘한다고 할 때는 in이 아니라 at을 써요. “She is good at English”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “at”. good at으로 기억해요! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: Say good at, not good in. “She is good at English”.
en.caption: Do you say “She is good in English”? 😅 To say you are skilled at something, use “at”. “She is good at English” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
